title: Regular Expressions for Glycan Structures
text: glymotif provides concise syntax matching glycan motifs. However, exact motif matching may sufficient express complex structural constraints. example, sialyl-LacNAc motif without fucosylation specified using bare IUPAC-condensed sequence. address limitation, glyrex introduces dedicated glyco-regex syntax enables flexible expressive pattern matching.

title: Regular Expressions for Glycan Structures
code: library(glyrex) x <- c(   "Gal(b1-4)[Fuc(a1-3)]GlcNAc(a1-",   "Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-",   NA_character_ ) p <- rex_compile("Galb4-(Fuca3)-GlcNAc") rex_detect(x, p) #> [1]  TRUE FALSE    NA rex_extract(x, p) #> [1] "Fuc(a1-3)[Gal(b1-4)]GlcNAc(a1-" NA #> [3] NA rex_match(x, "(?<antenna>Galb4)-GlcNAc") #>      match                 antenna #> [1,] "Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(a1-" "Gal(b1-" #> [2,] "Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-" "Gal(b1-" #> [3,] NA                    NA rex_locate_all(x, p) #> [[1]] #>     nodes edges #> 1 1, 2, 3  1, 2 #> #> [[2]] #> [1] nodes edges #> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names) #> #> [[3]] #>   nodes edges #> 1    NA    NA

title: Compile a Glycan Regular Expression — rex_compile
text: Residues separated -. Linkages accept shorthand (Galb4) IUPAC notation (Gal(b1-4)). . matches residue; Hex, HexNAc, glyrepr classes match concrete members. Sia matches Neu5Ac, Neu5Gc, Kdn. [Gal|Man] expresses alternatives; [^Fuc] excludes residues. Parentheses describe sibling branch, Galb4-(Fuca3)-GlcNAc. (!...-) always asserts branch absence: (!Fuc-) forbids Fuc branch linkage, whereas (!Fuca3-) forbids alpha1-3 Fuc branch. assertion checks unconsumed branches attached next residue, consumes nodes, can contain multi-residue branch pattern. Write attachment dash inside group, immediately ), followed directly attachment residue: Galb4-(!Fuc-)GlcNAc. Bare !residue absence groups without final dash rejected. Bracketed groups accept ?, *, +, {n}, {n,m}, {n,}, {,m}. Append ? lazy repetition. Open bounds limited input graph, fixed repeat count. ^ requires non-reducing terminus, $ reducing end, % internal residue. Lookahead (?=...) / (?!...) tests reducing-end direction; lookbehind (?<=...) / (?<!...) tests non-reducing direction. Assertions consume residues. Empty matches returned. (?<name>...) captures path (extension glycowork); (?:...) groups path without capture. Ordinary parentheses remain branches. capture name match reserved full-match result column. omitted anomer unconstrained. GlcNAca constrains anomer either internal residue reducing end. GlcNAc(a1- explicitly requires reducing end anomeric position, using glyrepr notation. closed form, GlcNAc(a1-), also accepted inside groups. specified acceptor position, e.g. GlcNAca4, requires outgoing glycosidic linkage match reducing end. Unknown linkage fields wildcards either side, following glycowork; ambiguous positions match possible values overlap.

Extraction returns canonical glyrepr IUPAC strings character input glyrepr structure vectors structure graph input. cut fragment retains anomer donor position former attachment linkage. rex_match() returns character matrix match followed named capture columns; unmatched captures NA. rex_match_all() returns list matrices, zero rows match one missing row missing input. Vectorized patterns must identical capture names. rex_locate() returns data frame integer list-columns nodes edges; rex_locate_all() returns list data frames. IDs one-based refer input graph, canonical graph obtained character input, glyrepr::structure_nodes() glyrepr::structure_edges(). edges within match returned. First locations use NA_integer_ match missing input; locations use zero rows match one missing row missing input. rex_subset() preserves input representation names; rex_which() returns matching indices. omit missing results require pattern length one length string.

title: Query Glycan Structures with Regular Expressions — rex_query
text: matching unit connected structural trace. glycowork, first successful trace per starting node retained, strict subsets traces removed. Distinct branches equal sequences remain distinct matches. Matches ordered decreasing residue count starting node ID. Repeats greedy unless marked lazy; successful traces may overlap. Counts therefore need equal text-regex counts. connected rooted trees supported; floating topology floating substituents rejected explicitly. See rex_compile() syntax.

title: glyrex 0.0.0.9000
text: Branch absence requires (!branch-); bare !linked-residue groups missing final attachment dash rejected. [^] always consumes nonmatching residue, including linkage constraint. Residue negation uses [^]; [!] spelling rejected migration guidance. (!...-) always asserts branch absence: (!Fuc-) forbids Fuc branch attachment residue, (!Fuca3-) restricts forbidden branch alpha1-3 linkage. rex_compile() compiles glycowork-style glycan patterns branches, repetition, location anchors, lookaround, named captures, including glyrepr reducing-end configuration constraints. rex_detect(), rex_count(), rex_extract(), rex_extract_all(), rex_match(), rex_match_all(), rex_locate(), rex_locate_all(), rex_subset(), rex_which() provide stringr-style structural queries IUPAC strings glyrepr structures. Queries reject glycans floating parts floating substituents.
